solar.note: MCS certified installer needed for export payments.

heat_pump.note: The MCS installer applies for the grant and takes it off the bill. The saving assumes you also close the gas supply, so the gas standing charge goes.
heat_pump.recommendation: Worth it mainly if your boiler needs replacing soon

solar-ca-wall.plain: In a conservation area, panels may not go on a wall, balcony or roof enclosure that faces a road. The roof is fine.

solar-pitched.clause: GPDO Sch 2 Part 14 Class A, A.2(c)
solar-pitched.plain: On a pitched roof, panels may stand up to 20 cm proud of the roof and may not go above the ridge.

ashp-units.clause: GPDO Sch 2 Part 14 Class G, G.1(a) and (d)
ashp-units.plain: One outdoor unit for a house that shares a wall, two for a detached house. Each unit up to 1.5 cubic metres, and it must meet the MCS Planning Standards, including the noise limit.

ashp-ca-front.clause: GPDO Sch 2 Part 14 Class G, G.1(j)
ashp-ca-front.plain: In a conservation area, the unit may not go on a wall or roof that faces a road, or closer to the road than the house.

ewi-art23.clause: GPDO Sch 2 Part 1 Class A, A.2(a)

inside-insulation.clause: Town and Country Planning Act 1990, s.55(2)(a)
inside-insulation.plain: Work that only affects the inside of a building is not development, so insulating from the inside needs no planning permission (listed buildings still need consent).

vat-zero.plain: No VAT on installing solar panels, heat pumps or insulation in a home, until 31 March 2027.

events.sql:
SELECT d.dataset, d.reference, d.name, d.grade, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.entity, d.organisation,
       a.removes_solar, a.removes_ashp, a.removes_walls, a.summary AS a4_summary, a.source_url AS a4_source, a.end_date AS a4_end_date
FROM retrofit_pg.designation d
LEFT JOIN retrofit_pg.article4_rule a ON a.reference = d.reference
WHERE d.house_id = 'osm-way-110514126'
events.purpose: Protected areas, listing and Article 4, joined to what each Article 4 removes

events.sql: SELECT rule_id, measure, clause, plain, applies_when, effect, in_force, amended_by, source_url, checked_on FROM retrofit_pg.pd_rule
SELECT wall_no, facing_deg, length_m, fronts_highway, highway_name, distance_m, adjoins FROM retrofit_pg.house_wall WHERE house_id = 'osm-way-110514126' ORDER BY wall_no
SELECT fact_id, value, unit, plain, kind, valid_from, valid_to, source_url, checked_on FROM retrofit_pg.price_fact
events.purpose: Dated prices and costs for rough money

events.sql: SELECT scheme_id, measure, amount_gbp, plain, condition, valid_from, valid_to, source_url, checked_on FROM retrofit_pg.grant_scheme
SELECT facing, azimuth_deg, pitch_deg, area_m2 FROM retrofit_pg.roof_plane WHERE house_id = 'osm-way-110514126' ORDER BY area_m2 DESC
SELECT facing, kwp, kwh_year, params, source FROM retrofit_pg.pv_estimate WHERE house_id = 'osm-way-110514126'
SELECT noise_pct, flat_pct, eaves_m, ridge_m, method FROM retrofit_pg.roof_survey WHERE house_id = 'osm-way-110514126'
events.purpose: How clean the LIDAR roof reading is

events.sql: SELECT house_id, label, lat, lon, building, footprint_m2, source FROM retrofit_pg.house WHERE house_id = 'osm-way-110514126'

events.text: One cost figure would hide how much prices vary. Check the national median against the London average before quoting a cost.

events.purpose: Compare the two official solar cost series

events.text: National median £1,595 per kW, London average £2,101 per kW (32% apart). Showing £7,300 to £9,700 with both sources.
